Prices

Questions

How much do projects in support and design cost?
At Qilich an MVP in this group costs $500–8,000 (UZS 6–97 mln), a full version up to $50,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does a project in support and design take?
Qilich builds an MVP in 1–5 weeks and a full version in 2–20 weeks.
What do we need to provide for a project in support and design?
The project's code and documents, access rights, a contact person.
